method: Read-only source, frozen-source hash and recorded fixture-summary inspection; no numerical rerun.

resolved_finding.issue: Source could change after eligibility validation and before snapshot copying, leaving a newly copied source set unrelated to the reviewed O3 parity inputs.
resolved_finding.fix: The launcher rechecks every frozen src/CMake member against the parity guarded-source map and pins the reviewed guard main before building.

checks: Terminal preflight, full-reference and explicit accuracy-review hash links gate the one DD command.
Mathematical headers and CMake match frozen 004; the reviewed guard main, copied build records, compiler and O3 parity artifacts are pinned.
Exclusive output and atomic execution ledger retain subprocess status; process-group termination completes before failed-run hashes are finalized.
Native event/observation metadata, residual initializer flags, coverage, matrix dimensions and history ray/initializer counts are checked.
Completed outputs retain pending-final-diagnostics status and scientific_success=false.
limitations: No real inversion, reference evaluation, ray tracing or numerical test was rerun for this review.
This source review does not certify first arrivals, final 3D accuracy or nonlinear convergence.
Recorded fixture results are distinguished from this independent source inspection.
